title: 帮刘奶奶摘菜
target: agreeing to help; repeating an order with the measure words 个 and 根
curriculumStatus: Beginner prototype; HSK level mapping and native-speaker review pending

nodes.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ néng bāng wǒ zhāi cài ma?
nodes.en: Hello! Could you help me pick vegetables?
nodes.speaker: liu

nodes.zh: 请帮我摘三个西红柿和两根黄瓜。
nodes.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ zhāi sān ge xīhóngshì hé liǎng gēn huángguā.
nodes.en: Please pick me three tomatoes and two cucumbers.
nodes.note: 个 and 根 are measure words: 根 is for long thin things like cucumbers and carrots. 西红柿 is also called 番茄.
nodes.speaker: liu

prompt.pinyin: Zài shuō yí biàn tā yào shénme.

accepted: 三个西红柿和两根黄瓜
nodes.model: 三个西红柿和两根黄瓜。
choices: 三个西红柿和两根黄瓜。
